content.text:
Fixed in `lib/util/cache.js` (`parseCacheControlHeader`).

## The bug

`Cache-Control: private=""` (and `no-cache=""`) parsed into an array containing one empty field name:

```
private=""   =>  { private: [""] }
private="    =>  { private: [""] }   // unterminated quote treated as valid
private= x   =>  { private: [""] }   // whitespace-only value
```

That is wrong in a way that matters downstream in `lib/handler/cache-handler.js`: the shared-cache guard is `cacheControlDirectives.private === true` (line 432), so an array slipped past it and a response marked `private=""` was stored in a *shared* cache. The empty string then went into `headersToRemove`, stripping nothing. The unterminated-quote case was also accepted, because a lone `"` satisfied both the "starts with quote" and "ends with quote" checks.

There was also a latent crash on the same path: `private, private="x"` threw `output[key].concat is not a function`, since the unqualified form sets `true` and the qualified branch then called `.concat` on a boolean.

## The change

- Field names are trimmed and empty ones dropped; a qualified `private`/`no-cache` whose list ends up empty is recorded as unqualified `true` — it restricts nothing, so per RFC 9111 the directive applies to the whole response (the safe direction: shared caches now refuse to store it).
- An ending quote now requires `value.length > 1`, so `private="` falls into the existing "missing ending quote → skip" behavior already covered by a test.
- Merging of repeated directives moved into a new `addQualifiedDirective` helper, where an existing unqualified `true` wins instead of throwing.

## Verification

- `test/cache-interceptor/*.js` — 68 pass (includes two new test cases I added to `test/cache-interceptor/utils.js` for empty-qualified and unqualified-precedence).
- `test/interceptors/cache*.js` — 72 pass, including the RFC 9111 §3.5 authenticated-request suite.
- `test/cache/*.js` — 4 pass.
- Lint (`npx standard`) needed approval I don't have, so it is unrun; the edit follows the file's existing style.

Per COMPLEX.md: `lib/util/cache.js` is listed as a hotspot but has no paragraph under "Why these files are hot" and no `co_change`/`seams` partner. I checked the type seam anyway — `types/cache-interceptor.d.ts` already declares `private?: true | string[]` and `'no-cache'?: true | string[]`, so the partner needed no change. Not committed.
